title: Onboarding form
intendedUserGoal: Complete setup with clear field requirements and a confident next action.

strongFindings.rootCause: Skip and continue actions do not clearly communicate priority.
Required-state feedback is visually small and soft.

rootCauseObservations: Completion confidence is the main issue; field-level nits should support that point.
mergeGuidance: Keep action clarity and error visibility separate if both affect completion.
scannerSpamToAvoid: Do not generate one finding per input if the root issue is flow clarity.
